messages:
PagerDuty Bot: PAGER: high GPU queue growth detected for eu-west-1-gpu-pool-3 (95% util, 4m sustained). queue_length increased >> 250 in 3m. autoscaler attempted scale-up but failed with errors: "scale request rejected: pool max_replicas=8 reached". paging oncall. incident_id=inc-2210007890
Alex (oncall): I’m on it. grabbing metrics and autoscaler logs. setting status: investigating :mag:
Maria - SRE: noted - i see the pool max limit is 8 in config. did anyone recently change max_replicas for eu-west? @Ryan?
Ryan (infra): no config PRs from infra in last 24h. there was a policy change earlier to cap burst pools for cost—but that was for us-east only. looking at k8s events for the autoscaler now.
Sam (runtime): getting logs from runtime: looks like many requests are hitting the large-model tier. latency spikes around the same time. also seeing KV cache miss rate jump.
Alex (oncall): command runs: ```kubectl -n inference describe hpa eu-west-1-gpu-pool-3``` shows maxReplicas: 8 currentReplicas: 8 events: "Failed to scale up: quotaExceeded: projectLimit"
Maria - SRE: two failure modes: autoscaler config cap or backend provider returned capacityDenied. check provider API error in autoscaler logs: ```kubectl -n infra logs deploy/autoscaler --since=10m | grep eu-west-1-gpu-pool-3```
Sam (runtime): pasted logs: "provider_scale_error: AllocationError: InsufficientPoolCapacity" and "requeueing scale request, backoff 30s"
Alex (oncall): ok so both cap and provider shortage possible. immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily increase pool max_replicas (quick config bump), 2) enable fallback routing to smaller model family, 3) apply throttling to non-prod tenants, 4) open provider support ticket. which do we want now?
Clara (CSM): Heads-up from CS: 3 paying customers reporting 504s / degraded throughput on europe region. one is on a high-throughput path (nlp-indexing). they want ETA.
Alex (oncall): @Clara give me the customer ids and I'll add them to incident page. ETA TBD; first we need stabilise cluster.
Ryan (infra): I can flip the max_replicas to 12 via feature toggle for eu-west-1 pool. that bypasses PR churn. pushing change to feature-config now.```apply patch```
Eng Bot: Deploy starting: feature-config update eu-west-1.gpu_pool.max_replicas=12 by Ryan (infra). CI job #7821 started.
Maria - SRE: while that rolls, please enable fallback routing. Sam, can you enable model-route fallback for eu-west to use smaller-medium models for unnamed heavy routes?
Sam (runtime): On it. toggling routing policy: ```redwoodctl route update --region eu-west-1 --policy fallback_to_medium --selector workload=high_throughput```. Applying now.
Alex (oncall): Also applying quick token-based rate limit for anonymous/low-tier keys to reduce pressure: ```redwoodctl quotas update --region eu-west-1 --tier free --rps 5```.
Eng Bot: Feature-config update succeeded. max_replicas now 12. autoscaler acknowledged new limit and initiated scale up.
PagerDuty Bot: ALERT RESOLVED: queue_length trending down after 90s post config change. util dropping to 72% in last minute.
Maria - SRE: Great. provider errors still present but now we have breathing room. need post-incident action items: - audit why eu-west pool was capped to 8 unexpectedly, - add provider error handling to autoscaler to fail open to fallback models sooner, - improve customer-facing alerting (map to CSM queue).
Alex (oncall): timeline for postmortem: I'll own incident doc and timeline. Sam to do autoscaler log deep-dive. Ryan to trace config origin and rollout history. Clara to surface impacted customers and compose comms.
Clara (CSM): I'll reach out to the three customers now with interim note: investigating, mitigation applied, follow-up with RCA.
Sam (runtime): initial root cause hypothesis: a combination of an old hard cap in feature-config + transient provider capacity denial. autoscaler didn't fail fast to fallback routing, so large-model traffic continued to pile up. need to add a failover threshold so if allocation errors exceed X over Y secs, route to alternate model family automatically.
Maria - SRE: Agreed. also add an alert: if queue_length>200 AND scale_requests_rejected>5 in 5m -> page SRE lead + Product (so we can do traffic shaping).
Alex (oncall): action items and owners: - Incident doc + timeline (Alex) - Autoscaler fallback policy + tests (Sam) - Config audit + revert safe-guard (Ryan) - Customer comms + transcript (Clara) - Add new alert rule (Maria) Target due dates: 72h for fixes, 24h for interim customer comms.
Ryan (infra): I'll also add a temporary guardrail to prevent accidental cap changes without two approvers.
Eng Bot: CI jobs created: #7822 (config audit), #7823 (autoscaler unit tests).
Alex (oncall): closing incident in slack for now. switching to postmortem channel thread. If queue grows again, page oncall immediately. thanks everyone :heart: 
Clara (CSM): will share the customer updates in 15m.
Maria - SRE: leaving a note: collect autoscaler metrics for last 48h + cache miss heatmap for postmortem.
Sam (runtime): taking logs + sample request traces for customers impacted. attaching to incident doc.
Alex (oncall): last status: stabilized, low customer errors, monitors recovering. end of realtime thread.
